comment: getpos.c auto_describe() witness: with autodescribe on, farlook switches to the target menu with '!', then 'm' finds no monster but the hero, so getpos_menu() prints "You cannot detect any monsters." without setting msg_given. The following auto_describe() is custompline(SUPPRESS_HISTORY | OVERRIDE_MSGTYPE | NO_CURS_ON_U): show_topl() replaces that line instead of appending to it. A cursor move and a second 'm' repeat the pair before '.' picks the spot.
